subject: 📊 Daily Portfolio: No live P&L (feed outage is total, not Yahoo-specific) | SPXC reconciliation 44 days overdue
html_body:
🚨 Data outage, day 29 — and it's bigger than we thought

Yahoo (query1 + query2) and stooq failed again today — the 29th straight day. But today I also tested google.com, wsj.com, and a plain example.com fetch as a control, and all three failed the same way. A direct proxy check returned a flat 403 (organization egress denial), not a DNS fluke. That changes the diagnosis: this was never a finance-sites-only block — it's a total webfetch block for this session, and has probably been masking as "Yahoo/stooq specific" for a month. Websearch (not direct fetch) still works, which is how every price and news item below was sourced — but nothing below is a live quote. Check IBKR directly before acting on anything.

Exit & Reconciliation Alerts

🔔 SPXC — reconciliation now 44 calendar days overdue

Exit decision was logged 2026-08-25 (Kranze defense-segment halal breach). portfolio.json still lists 0.5 shares open with stop $186.90 / exit-limit $205, but two independent IBKR snapshots (Sep 29 and Oct 6, via the stock-finder routine, 8 days apart, cash matching exactly at $432.16) show no SPXC position — consistent with the $205 exit-limit filling for a small net profit (~+$3.54), not the stop.
Separately: web data today puts SPXC's actual market price at ~$173 (Oct 2) — well below the $186.90 stop. If the position were still open, the stop should have fired weeks ago regardless of which exit got there first.
This isn't a new finding — it's the same gap flagged on Oct 1, 4, and 7 with no resolution. This routine only reads portfolio.json; it can't close this out itself. Needs you to confirm the fill in IBKR and run portfolio-manager to remove the position and sync cash to ~$432.16.

Don't deploy new cash today. Confirm the real cash figure via IBKR first (same action item as the SPXC reconciliation above — it's the same underlying sync). Once that's done and if $30+ is genuinely free after the $2 commission reserve, this section will carry a real recommendation. No discovery candidate generated here by design — that's stock-finder's job, run on demand.

🔄 Rotation Suggestions

None today. GOOG isn't at a trim trigger (no TP hit, stop not threatened), the watchlist has no live candidates, and sizing any move off an unreconciled cash balance would be guessing. Best move is closing the SPXC/cash gap before considering anything else.

📚 Today you learned

Working Blind, Part 4 — A Total Block Isn't the Same Failure as a Blocked Host

The last month's GOOG/SPXC price gaps came from specific hosts (Yahoo, stooq) being denied — a targeted block. Today was different: every test, including a plain example.com fetch, failed the same way, and a direct proxy check returned a flat 403. That's a session-level egress policy, not a finance-data problem — it means nothing web-based was fetchable today, not just prices. The distinction matters for how much to trust "no data": a host-specific block still lets search-based cross-checks through (which is how the SPXC/$173 and GOOG/$343.50 reference points below came from), while a total block means even those are running on whatever's cached in search results, not anything verified live. Know which kind of blind you're flying before you decide how much to trust the numbers in front of you.

Also today: Egress policy — the allowlist/denylist a network sits behind; a 403 from a policy proxy means "not permitted," not "unreachable."

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Verify halal compliance quarterly on Zoya or Musaffa.
Prices: web-search reference only. No live quotes were available for this report. Generated Oct 8, 2026, Kuwait time.
